default_recursive.description: Send recursive query by default. Set to false to enable authoritative mode (-a).

default_tcp.description: Use TCP instead of UDP for transport. Default is UDP (-u); true enables -t.

default_dnscurve_streamlined.description: Use DNSCurve streamlined format (-s). Set to false to disable streamlined mode. Ignored for regular DNS.

dnscurve_txt_suffix.description: DNSCurve TXT format suffix (e.g., 'cz') for TXT-based DNSCurve queries. Ignored for regular DNS or if streamlined mode is used.

dnscurve_public_key.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte DNSCurve server public key. Required only when using DNSCurve mode.

default_timeout.description: Query timeout in seconds (1-60). Default is 60.

default_port.description: Default port for DNS queries (applies only when host is specified explicitly).

default_host.description: Default DNS server host (IP or hostname) for authoritative queries or when overriding /etc/resolv.conf.
